gloss: to neglect; to be negligent; to fail to do

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {怠|おこた}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To fail to do something that should be done, often due to laziness or carelessness.

definitions.gloss: to be lazy about; to slack off on
definitions.explanation: To not put sufficient effort into a duty or task.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}ると、⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: If you neglect your studies, your grades will drop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}って⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You must not neglect safety checks.
examples.notes: [Note: {怠|おこた}って⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ + ⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧ = must not neglect]

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}らなければ、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功：02638_seikou⟧。
examples.english: If you don't slack off on your efforts, you will surely succeed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}っていた⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: I had been slacking off on practice, so I lost the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}っていたら、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|きたな}く→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was lazy about cleaning, and the room got dirty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}ると、⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: If you slack off on daily exercise, your stamina declines.

notes:
{怠|おこた}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). It takes を to mark what is being neglected.

ASPECT (ている):
The ている form indicates an ongoing state of neglect (⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}っている = 'is neglecting one's duty').

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [duty/task]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}る (neglect ~)
- ⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}る (neglect a duty)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}る (slack off on effort)
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}る (be negligent in attention)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|おこた}る (neglect health management)

This verb has a somewhat formal tone and is often used in written contexts. The related noun is ⟦{怠慢|たいまん}→怠慢：15721_taiman⟧ (negligence).
